We're Neruvo, a small team based in Accra, Ghana. We built our GraphQL schema registry because “who owns this field?” should have an answer somewhere other than a forgotten conversation. New Year resolutions feel like a good excuse to put the schema cupboard in order, and we'd love to get more people trying it.

Please run our X campaign from Monday, January 4, 2027 through Wednesday, January 6, 2027, using Accra time for the whole three-day flight. Our objective is as many completed free-trial sign-ups as possible; completed registrations are what we count. We serve developers and teams worldwide.

The landing page is https://neruvo.io/start. Here's the copy from our landing page:

"Neruvo is a GraphQL schema registry built in Accra, Ghana, that keeps schema versions, flags breaking changes and records who owns each field. Give your schemas a New Year reset with a 30-day free trial covering up to three graphs and five team members. Developers and teams worldwide can sign up. Start your trial by January 6, 2027."

Everything is localized: the product and the landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

Our site does not have X's pixel, so X can't see the sign-ups. You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please keep watching it throughout the flight, and send us a short recap at the end with spend, impressions and link clicks. A little less schema confusion would be a lovely way to start the year.

Total budget: 2,700.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
